title: PublicProcurement-IA: Brazilian public AI procurement corpus from PNCP
description:
Reproducible pipeline and analysis corpus for mapping Brazilian public contracts related to artificial intelligence in the Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas (PNCP).

This deposit packages (1) the software snapshot from the GitHub repository, (2) raw PNCP search hits used in the study, and (3) derived analysis outputs (classified contracts, figures, briefing).

Unit of analysis: contracts only (document_type=contrato) whose description matches the inclusion lexicon. Window: 2021-01-01 to 2026-09-30.

Source portal: pncp.gov.br. Search endpoint used for discovery: GET /api/search/.
